purpose: Document Nizamabad's official Telangana cadastral-source discovery and bounded anonymous requests while separating registry evidence from geometry and runtime qualification.
assessment: TGRAC's official Telangana ArcGIS REST layer provides credible cadastral polygon-service and schema evidence, and TGRAC documentation names Nizamabad District parcel-map work. The bounded exact-point feature query timed out or was rejected in format negotiation, so no native feature identity or polygon is retained. Runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official TGRAC cadastral layer and Nizamabad-specific Bhu Bharathi project documentation. This is official source evidence, not proof of citywide open geometry coverage or title/ownership data.

attempts: Performed separate English and Telugu first-party discovery queries and recorded actual result URLs.
Loaded TGRAC layer 0 metadata anonymously over TLS; verified polygon geometry, EPSG:4326, public Query/Data capability, max record count 1000, and native FID OID field.
Loaded TGRAC layer 1 metadata only; observed unsafe farmer/owner/contact-style fields and did not query or retain it.
Reviewed TGRAC project documentation; it explicitly names Nizamabad District Bhu Bharathi work, parcel-map layouts, spatial corrections, and geo-rectified village maps.
Attempted an anonymous exact-point query at immutable WUP point [18.6760713100723, 78.0987992055297] using safe outFields=FID and returnGeometry=true; request timed out after 30 seconds.
Attempted the same bounded query using f=geojson; service returned HTTP 400 without geometry.
Did not shift coordinates, log in, request owner/address/title/tax/contact fields, use credentials, bypass CAPTCHA/Cloudflare, or disable TLS verification.
No sample GeoJSON was created because no full parcel polygon response or safe native parcel identity was verified.
